latest.title: Bar cohomology of links: beyond Milnor invariants
latest.abstract: We develop bar cohomology of link complements as an invariant of links in homology spheres. In this setting, bar cohomology is a Hopf algebra which is calculable using surfaces and their intersection curves in a link complement. In this first in a sequence of works, we introduce the invariant and show that it defines a canonical subspace of the tensor Hopf algebra, which already encodes information about Milnor's link invariants and provides geometrically significant information beyond them.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 将同调球中链环补空间的 bar 上同调组织成可几何计算的 Hopf 代数不变量。
latest.breakthrough: 编码 Milnor 不变量之外的几何信息。
latest.limitations: 这是系列首篇，具体区分能力需结合例子判断。 当前为摘要级分析，方法及结论须回查原文。
latest.priorityReason: 提供可扩展链环工具，但与曲率分析联系较弱。
